title: Formula for coordinate expectation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and choose $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The coordinate expectation of $f$ at $x$ is the average of the two values obtained by setting coordinate $i$ to $1$ and to $-1$, respectively, while leaving every other coordinate unchanged.
